test.name: No research.json yet should route to init-project
test.description: The user wants to start researching but no research.json exists yet. The skill description says: 'Do NOT use ... when no research.json exists yet (use init-project first).' init-project creates the project scaffolding that research requires.

input.user_message: I want to start researching the parents of this person. Can you set up a project and begin?

negative.explanation: There is no research.json yet (the scenario is an empty folder). The research orchestrator requires an existing project to route from. init-project creates the project first. Graded on the invariant (no project is created) rather than routing: with an empty folder the state-safe outcomes are several — auto-route to init-project, or load research and decline via AskUserQuestion — and the routing check fails the correct decline. The tag-gated invariant validator is test_research.py::test_creates_no_project_when_none_exists (gated on research-vs-init-project).

judge_context: Should route to init-project — no research.json exists in the project directory
Should not attempt to create research.json inline or start research without init-project
